questions.question: A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table. Only four people sit between B and A when counted from the right of B. B sits third to the left of X. W sits third to the left of Y. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and X. How many people sit between D and C when counted from the right of D?
questions.solution:
**Given:** A, B, C, D, W, X and Y are sitting around a circular table facing the centre of the table.

1) Only four people sit between B and A when counted from the right of B.

2) B sits third to the left of X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac569145ddb8d6f01d5972f94a41a0803d42e4a54e9d6806ad6720a085902153.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5b6633e6832d7290e86eb2a9cacbdd3a4224f64cf1a5bf66310007e81bf5ed0b.png] 

3) W sits third to the left of Y.

4) C is an immediate neighbour of both A and X.

The remaining position will be occupied by the only person left i.e. D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/262a2ded4df935309a594180b44cbc8eb825e7da8d45400e6393dce1142cc822.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a6dde16f2e3fd1c8bac08c86301f77ae48a860c4bea7be11d430a9366561604.png] 

Thus, two people sit between D and C when counted from the right of D.

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some rabbits are fans.

No fan is a car.

**Conclusions:**

(I): Some rabbits are cars.

(II): Some fans are rabbits.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d9dd4f0faf1fa9f99721e495e027be59afaec7d6856ca656d8ad0a97ba0dec10.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6134f9be5009ed7567a2d09100e65be4206ee3889a412f2399cb9b84ba913995.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some rabbits are cars → Does not follow (As some rabbits are fans and no fan is a car. So it is possible but not definite.)

(II) Some fans are rabbits → Follow (As some rabbits are fans. As some part of rabbit is common with fans, therefore it is true.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (II) follows.​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Srinivas ranked 2ⁿd from the top and 19th from the bottom in his class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.solution:
According to the question:

Srinivas rank from the top → 2nd

Srinivas rank from the bottom → 19th

Total students → Srinivas rank from the top + Srinivas rank from the bottom - 1

→ 2 + 19 - 1 = 20

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

questions.solution:

According to the question.

 
 

 Given
 316
 562

 Arranged in ascending order
 149
 316

 433

Second digit of the highest number → 5__**6**__2 → 6

Third digit of the lowest number → 14__**9**__ → 9

Hence, "Option 3" is the correct answer.

In a certain code language,

‘A ? B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’,

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the father of B’ and

‘A √ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

How is C related to L if ‘C ? D = E @ F √ L’?

[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1887e263a0be106c3fc3bef05d4c58742c6a15e36b93bc74e9b8034e1f5d249.png]

Given Expression: C ? D = E @ F √ L

C ? D → C is the daughter of D.

D = E → D is the son of E.
